items.difficulty_reason: The lemma proves that for a locally Noetherian integral normal algebraic space the canonical map from the Picard group to the divisor class group is injective (statement lines 1262-1267). The proof (proof lines 1269-1329) reduces to showing that a meromorphic section with zero divisor trivializes the module, checks this etale locally over an integral affine chart, compares local equations over a discrete valuation ring at a codimension one point, and uses the intersection theorem for normal domains to conclude that the section and its inverse are global. H3: a long local-global argument with genuine valuation theoretic computations, written out in full.
